# imgui/

Dear ImGui — lightweight immediate-mode GUI for the Milestone 4 dashboard
(device dropdowns, translation toggle, Wait-k slider, latency telemetry).

Not fetched automatically. Vendor the core sources plus a platform backend
(e.g. `imgui_impl_glfw` + `imgui_impl_opengl3`, or `imgui_impl_win32` +
`imgui_impl_dx11`) when Milestone 4 begins.
Upstream: <https://github.com/ocornut/imgui>
